question:
I have a column name type_name . As Type_name is a keyword in dbt , I could not run my DBT model

select 
  type_name as type_name_ 
from {{ source('sn','accounts') }}

Could you please help me resolve this
title: type_name keyword as a column name in DBT
answer:
Assuming that type_name is an unquoted column name in the source table:

select 
  "TYPE_NAME" as type_name_ 
from {{ source('sn','accounts') }}
